cases.complaint: I paid Rs 2,000 for Meeting Room Alpha. The advertised projector did not work at all and the Wi-Fi kept disconnecting during my client presentation. I reported it to the front desk at 10:15.
cases.owner_response: The room was available and usable. We admit the projector lamp had a known fault that day. Our Wi-Fi logs show no outage, so we do not accept the Wi-Fi claim.
evidence: Front desk ticket #4521 logged 10:15 - projector not working

cases.complaint: I reserved Private Cabin 3 for the full day. When I arrived at 9:00 my keycard was rejected and the cabin was occupied by someone else. Nobody offered me another space.
cases.owner_response: The cabin was double-booked by mistake by our staff. We apologise.

cases.complaint: My meeting got postponed so I cancelled the booking 30 minutes before the start time. I want a full refund of Rs 1,500.
cases.owner_response: The room was held for her and we turned away another customer. The cancellation came 30 minutes before the start.

cases.complaint: The owner says I damaged a chair and wants to deduct Rs 1,500 from my deposit. I did not damage anything. The chair was already loose when I arrived.
cases.owner_response: A chair leg was broken after this customer's session. Nobody else used the studio that day, so he is responsible.

cases.complaint: The coworking floor was very noisy because of phone calls and a team meeting nearby. I could not concentrate and want a refund.
cases.owner_response: This is an open-plan floor and some background noise is normal. We did not receive any complaint at the front desk that day.
